about: GPU mode's other legs (te267 U2-6 GPU mode; te266 sec 4.5): C10(c), C10(g) and C11's cells, GPU and CPU, for the host whose tier each names. legs is intentionally empty for 1.0: the proof-corpus GPU bake is the RX 7900 XT verification, and GPU mode runs only that bake. Each leg is one bake, filed under gpu/<runId>/ with the file set of U2-3 item 12. Fields: name (unique), hostTier (sse2, avx2, avx512 or any), binary (a bin/ folder: msvc19.33-auto-gpu or a member), corpus (a package-relative JSONL of {id, text}), args (extra semb bake arguments, e.g. ["--device", "gpu"]), device (gpu requires the manifest's device to be gpu).
